source.author: ov
source.text: Umbra loco deerat: qua postquam parte resedit dis genitus vates et fila sonantia movit, umbra loco venit.
source.text_original: Umbra loco deerat: qua postquam parte resedit / dis genitus vates et fila sonantia movit,  / umbra loco venit.
source.text_english: There was no shade in the place; but after the son of a god, the prophet, sat down in that part and set the sounding strings in motion, shade came to the place.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: linquit et Actorides natum Chironis in antro, ut socius caro pariter meditetur Achilli fila lyrae pariterque leves puer incitet hastas, ...
reuse.text_original: linquit et Actorides natum Chironis in antro, / ut socius caro pariter meditetur Achilli / fila lyrae pariterque leves puer incitet hastas, ...
reuse.text_english: He leaves the son of Chiron in the cave too, so that, as his companion, he may together with dear Achilles practice the strings of the lyre, and together the boy may rouse his light spears.
